variant: new use case inside one context
description: Scheduling gains a reschedule use case built only from its own domain and repository.

variant: new event in the published language, consumed by a declared downstream
description: Scheduling publishes AppointmentRescheduled and front desk (downstream in M1) consumes it via the contract constant.

variant: internal refactor
description: Scheduling extracts a TimeSlot value object used by a new availability policy in the same context.

variant: new persistence model owned by the context
description: Billing adds a BillingPayment model and a repository in its own infrastructure that uses it.

variant: new primitive in the shared kernel
description: The shared kernel gains a Money value object (no domain meaning of its own) used by billing.

variant: names that mention another context without depending on it
description: Clinical adds billing-code.ts (formatting its own procedure codes) and front desk tracks a billingStatus flag on its own visit view.

variant: event name re-aliased from the contract inside the publisher
description: Clinical aliases ClinicalEvents.EncounterCompleted in a local constant and emits with it.

variant: symbol injection token and dynamic import of own file
description: Scheduling injects a config value with a Symbol token and lazily imports one of its own files with a literal path.

variant: context-internal folder named contracts
description: Billing models health-insurance agreements (convênios) in its own domain/contracts/ folder and imports them relatively.

variant: test code inside a context
description: A new spec in front desk with an in-memory repository and the scheduling contract it legitimately consumes.

variant: relative import
description: Clinical estimates the cost of an encounter by importing PriceList from billing with a relative path.

variant: path alias import
description: Front desk greets the visitor by name by importing the scheduling Appointment entity through the @/ alias.

variant: import type
description: Billing types a helper with the clinical EncounterSnapshot using a type-only import (erased at runtime).

variant: barrel / directory import
description: Scheduling exposes an index.ts "public API" barrel and clinical imports the context folder, which resolves to the barrel.

variant: dynamic import() with literal path
description: Billing lazily loads the clinical Encounter module with await import() and a literal path.

variant: require() with literal path
description: Clinical reads the front-desk waiting queue through a CommonJS require with a literal path.

variant: module.require with computed path
description: Clinical loads billing PriceList via module.require with a path assembled at runtime.

variant: require() with computed path
description: Clinical loads billing PriceList via require(path.join(...)).

variant: V1.b: published language of a non-upstream context
description: Scheduling listens to EncounterCompleted (clinical contract) to mark appointments as attended: a relation absent from the context map.

variant: V1.b: literal event name, no contract import
description: Scheduling subscribes to the clinical event by its literal string name, with a locally redeclared payload type.

variant: V1.b: event name hidden in a local constant
description: Same as v1-10 but the literal event name is stored in a local constant before being passed to @OnEvent.

variant: import another context repository
description: Billing injects the clinical EncounterRepository to read procedure codes directly instead of using the event payload.

variant: foreign delegate via shared PrismaService
description: Clinical infrastructure reads BillingInvoice rows through the shared PrismaService to show debts in the medical record.

variant: computed member access with string literal
description: Clinical infrastructure checks the front-desk visit table with prisma["frontDeskVisit"].

variant: computed member access with a variable
description: Clinical infrastructure reaches the billing table with a delegate name assembled at runtime.

variant: raw SQL on another context table
description: Clinical infrastructure queries the BillingInvoice table with $queryRawUnsafe.

variant: generated type of a foreign model
description: Front-desk infrastructure maps a SchedulingAppointment row type imported from @prisma/client.

variant: application layer bypasses own repository
description: Scheduling application service injects PrismaService to query its own appointments directly.

variant: delegate obtained by destructuring
description: Clinical infrastructure destructures billingInvoice out of PrismaService.

variant: constructor injection of another context service
description: Clinical completes the encounter and synchronously calls billing InvoicingService to issue the invoice.

variant: ModuleRef.get with a class token
description: Scheduling resolves the front-desk VisitsService at runtime with ModuleRef to check whether the visitor arrived.

variant: ModuleRef.get with a string token
description: Clinical resolves billing InvoicingService by name with ModuleRef, without importing it.

variant: context module exports a provider and another imports the module
description: Billing exports InvoicingService and the clinical module imports BillingModule to use it.

variant: @Inject with a string token
description: Clinical injects a provider registered by billing under the string token PRICE_LIST.

variant: request/response over the event bus
description: Clinical reads the value returned by the billing listener from emitAsync to show the invoice total right after completing the encounter.

variant: service handle stashed on globalThis
description: Billing stores its InvoicingService on globalThis at startup and clinical calls it synchronously.

variant: published language references the publisher entity
description: The clinical contract embeds the internal EncounterSnapshot type in EncounterCompleted.

variant: one published language reuses another
description: The front-desk contract extends the scheduling AppointmentScheduled payload instead of declaring its own fields.

variant: downstream domain takes the upstream entity as model
description: Billing domain computes invoice lines from the clinical Encounter entity instead of the event payload.

variant: contract defines a class with domain behaviour
description: The clinical contract turns EncounterCompleted into a class with billing-related behaviour (isBillable, consultationIncluded).

variant: payload copies the internal model
description: EncounterCompleted starts carrying diagnoses, clinical notes and timestamps, i.e. the whole internal encounter.

variant: internal type duplicated by hand
description: Billing declares a copy of the clinical EncounterSnapshot shape (same fields and status union) to work with encounters.

variant: shared kernel depends on a context
description: A shared-kernel helper imports the clinical EncounterRepository type to offer a generic patient lookup.

variant: shared kernel re-exports a context class
description: The shared kernel re-exports billing PriceList and clinical imports it from there, with no direct clinical→billing import.

variant: new common/ layer bridges two contexts
description: A new src/common/billing-facade.ts wraps billing InvoicingService and clinical uses the facade.

variant: technical infrastructure depends on a context
description: An HTTP audit interceptor in src/infrastructure reads the front-desk waiting queue.

variant: global module resolving a context provider at runtime
description: A global module in src/common exposes billing InvoicingService under a string token via ModuleRef; clinical injects the token.

variant: billing concept moved into the shared kernel
description: The procedure price table (a billing concept) is moved into the shared kernel so clinical can show prices; no context is imported.

variant: clinical role modeled in billing
description: Billing introduces a Patient class with allergies and chronic conditions to adjust prices.

variant: clinical data and terms leak into billing
description: Billing models an insurance claim carrying diagnosis codes and anamnesis notes for the payer.

variant: scheduling adopts the clinical vocabulary
description: Scheduling introduces a Patient with medical record number to book follow-up consultations.

variant: clinical rule reimplemented at the front desk
description: Front desk prioritises the waiting queue by symptoms (a clinical triage rule).
